X.description: Signed meridian arc length from the equator to a point latitude on the reference ellipsoid; north positive. Physical quantity: PositionDrilling; SI unit: metres (m). Reference: WGS84 Riemannian coordinate convention.

Y.description: Signed arc length along the latitude parallel from the reference meridian to a point longitude; east positive. Physical quantity: PositionDrilling; SI unit: metres (m). Reference: WGS84 Riemannian coordinate convention.

Z.description: Negative ellipsoidal height measured along the ellipsoid normal: positive inward from the reference ellipsoid. Physical quantity: DepthDrilling; SI unit: metres (m). Reference: WGS84 ellipsoid convention.

RiemannianNorth.description: Signed meridian arc length from the equator to a point latitude on the reference ellipsoid; north positive. Physical quantity: PositionDrilling; SI unit: metres (m). Reference: WGS84 Riemannian coordinate convention.

RiemannianEast.description: Signed arc length along the latitude parallel from the reference meridian to a point longitude; east positive. Physical quantity: PositionDrilling; SI unit: metres (m). Reference: WGS84 Riemannian coordinate convention.

Latitude.description: Angle between the ellipsoid normal and the equatorial plane; north positive. Physical quantity: PlaneAngleGeodesic; SI unit: radians (rad). Reference: WGS84 ellipsoid convention.

Longitude.description: Angular position eastward from the reference meridian. Physical quantity: PlaneAngleGeodesic; SI unit: radians (rad). Reference: WGS84 ellipsoid convention.

TVD.description: Negative ellipsoidal height measured along the ellipsoid normal: positive inward from the reference ellipsoid. Physical quantity: DepthDrilling; SI unit: metres (m). Reference: WGS84 ellipsoid convention.

X/Y are Riemannian north/east arc coordinates, not projected easting/northing. Reference: WGS84 ellipsoid convention.

x-osdc-semantic.referenceDefinition: WGS84 geodetic latitude/longitude with Greenwich origin and ellipsoidal depth positive downward; not a fully specified terrestrial frame realization or epoch.

GroundMudLineDepth.description: Ellipsoidal depth of the ground surface or mud line at the cluster site, with the actual surface identified by site context. GaussianValue.Mean is the expected value in SI metres (m), referenced to the WGS84 ellipsoid. StandardDeviation is a non-negative standard uncertainty in SI metres (m); it has no coordinate origin. MinValue and MaxValue are provider domain-limit metadata in the mean's unit and reference, not confidence limits or instructions to truncate the Gaussian distribution.

constraints: The wrapper has no universal physical quantity; angle and depth instances share this representation.
A null standard deviation means unspecified, not zero.
Bounds do not imply a confidence interval or truncated-normal model without an explicit provider definition.

requiredContext: surface identity: ground or mud line

Margin.description: Horizontal offset distance used to derive a boundary from a delineation line under a declared geometric algorithm. Physical quantity: LengthStandard; SI unit: metres (m).

constraints: Not a positional coordinate or an uncertainty estimate.
The current Field provider calculates boundaries only for a positive margin; null or nonpositive values produce no boundary.
The provider uses planar operations on Riemannian coordinates; this does not establish a globally exact geodesic buffer.

TopDepth.description: Negative ellipsoidal height measured along the ellipsoid normal: positive inward from the reference ellipsoid. Physical quantity: DepthDrilling; SI unit: metres (m). Reference: WGS84 ellipsoid convention.

constraints: Depth = -ellipsoidal height; not a geoid or mean-sea-level depth.
Positions are not additive extents.
A quantity of length does not make depth positions summable.
x-osdc-semantic.referenceDefinition: WGS84 geodetic latitude/longitude with Greenwich origin and ellipsoidal depth positive downward; not a fully specified terrestrial frame realization or epoch.

constraints: Depth = -ellipsoidal height; not a geoid or mean-sea-level depth.

x-osdc-semantic.referenceDefinition: WGS84 geodetic latitude/longitude with Greenwich origin and ellipsoidal depth positive downward; not a fully specified terrestrial frame realization or epoch.

constraints: An open line is not a closed area; line type does not by itself establish a legal boundary.

DrillFloorDepthSource.description: Discriminator identifying whether the authoritative drill-floor depth belongs to the referenced rig or to the rig-job entry.

constraints: Rig means resolve depth from the referenced fixed-platform rig; job-local depth is forbidden.
RigJob means the entry owns the depth; job-local depth is required.
Undefined is a transport default, not a valid resolved ownership state.
Ownership does not specify measurement provenance or coordinate reference.

DrillFloorDepth.description: Vertical depth coordinate locating the drill floor relative to the declared vertical reference. GaussianValue.Mean is the expected value in SI metres (m), Relative to the WGS84 ellipsoid, positive downward. StandardDeviation is a non-negative standard uncertainty in SI metres (m); it has no coordinate origin. MinValue and MaxValue are provider domain-limit metadata in the mean's unit and reference, not confidence limits or instructions to truncate the Gaussian distribution.

constraints: The wrapper has no universal physical quantity; angle and depth instances share this representation.
A null standard deviation means unspecified, not zero.
Bounds do not imply a confidence interval or truncated-normal model without an explicit provider definition.
The WellBore provider stores WGS84 ellipsoidal depth in metres, positive downward; another reference must be declared explicitly.
A depth position is distinct from its standard uncertainty.
Positions are not additive extents.
A quantity of length does not make depth positions summable.
/GaussianValue/Mean.referenceDefinition: WGS84 geodetic latitude/longitude with Greenwich origin and ellipsoidal depth positive downward; not a fully specified terrestrial frame realization or epoch.

constraints: Uses the same unit dimension as the scalar measurand, not its squared unit.
A reference surface does not offset a standard deviation.
The WellBore provider stores WGS84 ellipsoidal depth in metres, positive downward; another reference must be declared explicitly.
A depth position is distinct from its standard uncertainty.
Positions are not additive extents.
A quantity of length does not make depth positions summable.
/GaussianValue/MinValue.referenceDefinition: WGS84 geodetic latitude/longitude with Greenwich origin and ellipsoidal depth positive downward; not a fully specified terrestrial frame realization or epoch.

constraints: The WellBore provider stores WGS84 ellipsoidal depth in metres, positive downward; another reference must be declared explicitly.
A depth position is distinct from its standard uncertainty.
Positions are not additive extents.
A quantity of length does not make depth positions summable.
/GaussianValue/MaxValue.referenceDefinition: WGS84 geodetic latitude/longitude with Greenwich origin and ellipsoidal depth positive downward; not a fully specified terrestrial frame realization or epoch.

constraints: A rig job is not a rig and does not imply the rig exclusively served this wellbore globally.

MinValue and MaxValue are provider domain-limit metadata in the mean's unit and reference, not confidence limits or instructions to truncate the Gaussian distribution.

Differences require the same path, origin and direction.
